deities.name: Hathruna
deities.rationale: Rootlike limbs, seed nurseries, living growth, and seasonal garden renewal place them under the Root-Mother.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.rationale: Terrace gardens, nurseries, and community food systems connect them to harvest and village plenty.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Marduthor
deities.rationale: Living silk bridges and anchored architecture make sacred construction a major secondary tradition.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
